主要内容: The document titled 't1111306k.htm' is a Form 6-K filing by Royal Bank of Canada, dated January 14, 2013. It outlines the issuance of $1.25 billion in Senior Global Medium-Term Notes, Series E, with a coupon rate of 1.500% and a maturity date of January 16, 2018. The filing includes various legal opinions and consents from Sullivan & Cromwell LLP and Norton Rose Canada LLP regarding the validity of the notes and U.S. federal income taxation. The report is incorporated by reference into the Bank’s Registration Statement on Form F-3 (File No. 333-171806). The filing is signed by James Salem, Executive Vice-President and Treasurer of Royal Bank of Canada.
